wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2020–21 |team=Northern Kentucky Norse |sport=Basketball |image= NKU Norse logo.png |image_size=200 |conference=Horizon League |division= |short_conf=Horizon |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=14–11 |conf_record=11–7 |head_coach=[[Darrin Horn]] |hc_year = 2nd |asst_coach1=David Harris |asst_coach2=[[Eric Haut]] |asst_coach3=Simon McCormack |stadium=[[BB&T Arena]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2020–21 Horizon League men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball team''' represented [[Northern Kentucky University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Norse, led by second-year head coach [[Darrin Horn]], played their home games at [[BB&T Arena]] in [[Highland Heights, Kentucky]] as members of the [[Horizon League]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball team|Norse]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 23–9, 13–5 in Horizon League play to finish in second place. They defeated [[2019–20 Green Bay Phoenix men's basketball team|Green Bay]] and [[2019–20 UIC Flames men's basketball team|UIC]] to become champions of the [[2020 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]]. They received the Horizon League's automatic bid to the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]].
